text:
emily_ops: Heads up — pushing hotfix v2026.3.1 to prod to address intermittent embed timeout spikes seen since 18:00 UTC. Requesting expedited approval to skip a full canary and do a targeted rollout in the 23:00-23:30 change window. Patch: kv-cache eviction fix + quant kernel guard. No schema changes.

liam_release: what's the blast radius? any DB or migration work?

emily_ops: no DB/migrations. single runtime change and image bump. Blast radius: embedding service only (api-prod-01/02). Risk: small p50 increase possible while reducing 503s. Staging perf + smoke ✅.

raj_sre: confirm monitoring + rollback playbook, and who will be watching?

emily_ops: maya_engineering on watch for the window. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/boards/embed-slo. Runbook: /runbooks/embed-timeout. Rollback criteria: p99 > 1.5s OR errors > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback.

maya_engineering: I can be on watch. If p99 > 1.5s or error rate > 0.5% i will trigger rollback. i'll be available via this thread and @pager.

deploybot: Deploy command queued by emily_ops: `deploy release v2026.3.1 --env=prod --targets=api-prod-01,api-prod-02 --skip-canary --owner=emily_ops`

releasebot: Release notes published: https://changelogs/release-v2026.3.1. Summary: fix kv-cache eviction causing embedding timeouts. Pinned image: gcr.redwood/serve:v2026.3.1

liam_release: +1 to expedite assuming maya is watching and rollback criteria are actionable. Please call out any impacted customers.

emily_ops: no VIP customers affected, random clients saw 5-8% 503s, should improve. starting rollout in ~5m. will bump autoscaler to 1.2x for initial 10m.

deploybot: initiating rollout to api-prod-01 (10%), api-prod-02 (10%). health checks running.

emily_ops: health checks green on both nodes. metrics look nominal, p50 up ~6% but p99 stable.

maya_engineering: seeing tiny p50 uptick, p99 stable. edge retries noted for a small client group, errors ~0.18% currently.

raj_sre: prepare fast rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/embed-serving embed=gcr.redwood/serve:v2026.2.9 --namespace=prod` — ready to execute if errs > 0.5%.

liam_release: tagging release as expedited and pinging docs + support.

emily_ops: continuing to 50% then full after 10m stable. anyone veto?

maya_engineering: no veto, monitoring active. :thumbsup:

deploybot: progressing rollout -> 50% -> 100%... completed. All pods at v2026.3.1.

emily_ops: rollout finished, metrics look stable. closing thread; will file a 1-paragraph note in #release-notes and open a brief postmortem if anything regresses. Thanks all.
